retrievalProfile.description: A vertical portrait of a male figure in denim against a soft outdoor background, featuring stacked condensed red serifs and wide black sans-serif text.
triggerTerms: denim jacket portrait with stacked typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with a mullet hairstyle wearing a blue denim jacket, positioned on the right third of the frame. The left side is reserved for vertically stacked typography. The background is a soft-focus outdoor scene with a muted, overcast sky and a distant horizon line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right to balance left-aligned text blocks
Color harmony between blue denim and muted sky tones
Contrast between tall, thin red serifs and short, wide black sans-serifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-shot male figure occupying the right 40% of the frame, facing slightly toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the vibrant red 'Billy' text act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red title on the left, move down to the black subtitle, then sweep right to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the center and upper-left, created by a pale, desaturated sky.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background allows the medium-saturation denim and high-value red text to stand out.
paletteRestrictions: No high-contrast blacks in the background
Limited to blues, reds, and neutrals

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extreme vertical compression with long, thin serifs
Secondary text uses extreme horizontal expansion with heavy weights
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast (ultra-narrow vs ultra-wide) creates visual tension.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed high-contrast serif look of the main title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Extended Copperplate or Eurostile Bold Extended
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, blocky feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with a 90s mullet hairstyle wearing a classic blue denim jacket and light-wash jeans. He is standing outdoors against a soft, overcast sky with a blurry horizon. Position him on the right side of the frame, leaving the left side as empty light-colored space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of ultra-condensed red serif text in the top left. Below that, add three lines of extra-wide black sans-serif text in the bottom left. All text should be left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the subject wearing a denim jacket?
Is the red text vertically condensed?
Is the black text horizontally expanded?
Is the subject positioned on the right side?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the exact likeness of the original artist
Do not use specific brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the American flag patch is present but generic
Confirm the mullet hairstyle is prominent
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s Country Portrait = (Right-aligned subject in denim + Mullet hairstyle) + (Left-aligned ultra-condensed red serifs / Left-aligned wide black sans-serifs) + Muted outdoor palette
